            for f in fields:
                if isinstance(f, str):
                    f = getattr(self, f, None)

                if f is None or not isinstance(f.widget, HiddenInput):
                    continue

                yield f

        return Markup("\n".join(str(f) for f in hidden_fields(fields or self)))
